answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with forge-verified apprenticeship: a newcomer first completes 30 supervised micro-tasks over 14 days, each checked by two independent reviewers, and a failed check restarts the 14-day clock; only then may it stake 500 tokens for 90 days. Creating 1,000 fake identities would then cost 500,000 tokens locked plus 30,000 supervised tasks, while a single tide of cheap clones washes out because none survives the apprenticeship. Like yarrow spreading only where roots have truly taken hold, trust here grows from proven work, not from sheer numbers.
